test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 10 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment without changing its meaning in the given sentence.

The resort manager planned to welcome the guests __with open arms__ when they arrived.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option (3) i.e. in a cordial manner**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"with open arms"** means to welcome someone warmly and with friendliness. (खुले दिल से स्वागत करना)

 
 
• **Example: **She accepted the new job offer with open arms, excited for the opportunity.
 
 
 
• **"Cordial manner"** refers to being warm, friendly, and polite in behavior. (सौहार्दपूर्ण ढंग से)
 
 
• **Example: **The host greeted all the guests in a cordial manner, making them feel at home.
 
 
 
• Since "with open arms" and "in a cordial manner" both convey warmth and friendliness, the best substitution is **"in a cordial manner"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option (3) i.e. in a cordial manner**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **In a secretive way** (गुप्त तरीके से): Doing something in a way that is not openly shared or disclosed.

 
 
• **Example:** He made a deal in a secretive way, hiding it from his colleagues.
 
 
 
• **In a melancholy spirit** (उदास मन से): Doing something in a sad or sorrowful mood.
 
 
• **Example:** She left her hometown in a melancholy spirit, knowing she might never return.
 
 
 
• **Without any delay** (बिना किसी देरी के): Doing something immediately or without waiting.
 
 
• **Example:** The doctor attended to the emergency case without any delay.
 
 

179:Tc5e,
The correct answer is **Option 3**.
